objective: Optimise durable realised net P&L after measurable costs, not win count.

strategy_actions.reason: Quality and copied-loss controls are strong, but participation can be over-constrained in regime transitions.
Shadow-first mirror flow with stale-signal, round-trip loss, and entry deterioration checks aligns with safe research.
Risk controls are robust, but broader live use should wait for more measured shadow/near-live expectancy evidence.
Fail-closed token categorisation and quarantine integration reduce avoidable toxic-asset exposure.
Evidence classes are useful but should separate strong realised net proof from weaker flow inference before policy promotion.
Good governance wrapper; needs stronger weighting toward realised net-after-cost decision metrics.

existing_strategy_risks: Signal staleness and entry deterioration under latency bursts.
Small-notional entries can be overwhelmed by execution overhead.
Strict qualification gates can suppress opportunity participation.
Incomplete historical reconstruction can bias ranking confidence.

new_hypotheses.market_regime: Mixed/transition regimes with intermittent momentum and spread widening.
new_hypotheses.entry_hypothesis: Adaptive tightening/loosening of leader qualification thresholds based on recent realised net amount and drawdown trend will improve net expectancy versus fixed thresholds.
new_hypotheses.exit_logic: Use current independent exits; compare adaptive-threshold cohort vs fixed-threshold cohort on realised net outcomes.
required_data: Leader-level drawdown and recent PF windows
Rejection reason telemetry for skipped entries
new_hypotheses.expected_costs: No additional live cost in SHADOW; moderate compute and storage for cohort tagging.
new_hypotheses.shadow_test: Run parallel SHADOW cohorts for 14 days: fixed rules vs adaptive band. Require better median and total realised net in adaptive cohort with no worse max drawdown proxy.
new_hypotheses.falsification_criteria: Reject if adaptive cohort net/PF is not higher after costs, or if loss magnitude tail (p95 loss) worsens materially.

new_hypotheses.market_regime: Fast-moving launches/pumps where immediate copy suffers slippage and reversals.
new_hypotheses.entry_hypothesis: A short stabilisation delay with quote-quality confirmation (improved round-trip and deterioration bounds) reduces adverse selection and improves realised net after costs.
new_hypotheses.exit_logic: Retain existing exits; compare immediate-entry vs delayed-confirmed-entry SHADOW legs from same leader events.
required_data: Round-trip loss and deterioration snapshots over delay ladder
Resulting realised net by delay bucket
new_hypotheses.expected_costs: No live capital risk in SHADOW; added quote API usage and event buffering.
failure_modes: Lower fill rate reducing sample efficiency
Delay heuristic stale in rapidly changing liquidity
new_hypotheses.shadow_test: A/B SHADOW for 21 days across delay buckets (0s/3s/6s) with identical safety filters; target higher net SOL per trade and lower p95 loss in delayed-confirmed cohort.
new_hypotheses.falsification_criteria: Reject if delayed cohorts fail to beat immediate-entry realised net after costs or materially reduce participation without offsetting loss reduction.

must_not_change: Do not deploy or broaden LIVE execution pathways.
Do not alter capital, wallet/signing, or credential settings.
Do not loosen safety gates to increase trade count.
Any new or materially changed strategy remains SHADOW only until human approval.
